biotools.summary: BTE-RAG is a retrieval-augmented generation framework that augments large language models with mechanistic evidence retrieved via BioThings Explorer, a federation of more than sixty biomedical knowledge APIs, improving LLM accuracy on DrugMechDB-derived and GeneTuring biomedical benchmarks.
